note: After the original Latin description by Silvestri (1901) (new species Amitermes amifer sp. n., one of the original species of the genus); the paper is a "preliminary note" giving only a short diagnosis and describing the alate, the soldier being covered only by the generic characters. The measurements are values from a single specimen.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Generic characters: head with a fontanelle (fenestra); antennae 15-segmented; soldier mandibles sickle-shaped, antennae 13—14-segmented; anterior part of the middle of the pronotum upturned. The soldier of this species is not described separately in the original; the entry is based on the description of the alate of the new species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Antennal segment 3 very small, more than half shorter than segment 2; segments 4 and 5 subequal in length. Pronotum slightly wider than long, anterior corners rounded, narrowed posteriorly, with a median notch. Body length (with wings) 10.5 mm, body length without wings 5.6 mm. Locality: Argentina, Paraguay, Mato Grosso.
